name: Seekonk (Rhode Island parkland, very early fall)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Wannamoisett, Rumford RI: a Donald Ross parkland by the Seekonk River in the first days of fall (developer, 2026-10-19: some light yellowing/oranging of leaves, not full fall). Turf still green, a hair warmer than bayside; Ross white sand; still grey-green ponds; rough F0-F2 olive with a first hint of tan. Trees in assets-src/trees_seekonk.py: eastern white pine, oaks, and maples starting to turn. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
